jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Coventry School District, a town school district in the North Country Supervisory Union (member town: Coventry).
North Country Supervisory Union (official site hosting the district's board page).

sources.note: Coventry School Board page (North Country SU, official), 2026-2027 block: Praneet Menon (Chair), Sarah Bathalon (Vice Chair), Amanda Hussey (Clerk), Charles Conn, Jaime Stenger -- the same five in the September 16, 2026 full-board minutes and the March 18, 2026 reorganization minutes (which record Conn's and Hussey's March 2026 re-elections). The board is five directors at-large (16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b)); per-member term expirations are published nowhere reachable, so none are stated.
